name: rosetta-set-consolidation

use default

consolidate(input: LIST[SET[string]]) -> LIST[SET[string]] is
    let result = LIST[SET[string]]()

    for candidate in input do
        let merged = SET(candidate)
        let kept = LIST()

        for existing in result do
            if existing |> any(item => merged.contains(item)) then
                merged.union_with(existing)
            else
                kept.add(existing)
            fi
        od

        kept.add(merged)
        result.clear()
        result.add_range(kept)
    od

    result
si

render(sets: LIST[SET[string]]) -> string is
    let parts = LIST()

    for one in sets do
        let items = one |> collect_list()
        items.sort()

        parts.add("\{{items |> join(", ")}\}")
    od

    parts |> join(" ")
si

show(groups: string[][]) is
    let sets = LIST()

    for group in groups do
        sets.add(SET(group))
    od

    write_line("{render(sets)}")
    write_line("  consolidates to {render(consolidate(sets))}")
si

show([["A", "B"], ["B", "D"]])
show([["A", "B"], ["C", "D"], ["D", "B"]])
show([["H", "I", "K"], ["A", "B"], ["C", "D"], ["D", "B"], ["F", "G", "H"]])
